title: Late guarantor's debt: must the heirs pay it all?

scenes.dialogue: Your father stands guarantor for a company's loan, then passes away before it is repaid. Can the lender make you pay the entire debt from your own pocket?
scenes.chip: 1 · MUST THE HEIRS PAY IT ALL?

scenes.dialogue: Here, loans of seventy three and a half lakh grew into a decree of over forty crore, against the heirs too. The Karnataka High Court asked: must they pay it all?
scenes.shown: Here, loans of ₹73.5 lakh grew into a decree of over ₹40 crore, against the heirs too. The Karnataka High Court asked: must they pay it all?

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On twenty eighth October, Honourable Justice D K Singh and Honourable Justice H Shanthi Bhushan ruled.
scenes.shown: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On 28 October, Honourable Justice D.K. Singh and Honourable Justice H. Shanthi Bhushan ruled.

scenes.dialogue: In nineteen eighty eight and eighty nine, the Karnataka State Financial Corporation lent a granite company seventy three and a half lakh rupees.
scenes.shown: In 1988 and 1989, the Karnataka State Financial Corporation lent a granite company ₹73.5 lakh.

scenes.dialogue: A man stood guarantor, by unconditional and irrevocable guarantees; under their terms, his liability was joint and several. He has since passed away.
In July twenty twenty six, the Commercial Court held all the respondents, his heirs included, jointly and severally liable for over forty crore rupees.
scenes.shown: In July 2026, the Commercial Court held all the respondents, his heirs included, jointly and severally liable for over ₹40 crore.

scenes.dialogue: One heir appealed: heirs are liable only up to the estate they inherit. The corporation did not dispute that, but said they had not disclosed the inheritance.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, what did the High Court decide? A guarantor's death does not end his existing liability. It continues against the estate the heirs inherit.
But the heirs' own income and assets are not liable just by inheritance. The decree was modified: they answer only up to the estate, and must disclose it.
